focus: SAF URI validity and persisted publication URI
scope.method: Static review of the specified revision and deterministic branch tracing only. No source changes, emulator, app execution, deployment, or publication.
verified_behaviors: SAF successful rename consumes DocumentsContract.renameDocument returned URI, rather than continuing to use the obsolete documentId (PublicationReceipt.kt:123-128).

Failed rename after documentId change is rediscovered through exact final display name and verified by full fingerprint; the existing controlled provider/test explicitly covers this path (PublicationRecoveryTest.kt:53-64).
Unreadable verified output is preserved: fingerprint/open failure precedes deletion and verified mismatch paths call review (PublicationReceipt.kt:88-98).
FileAccess returns UNAVAILABLE for empty unknown-provider listings and recognizes only primary ExternalStorageProvider document IDs as known local storage (FileAvailability.kt:26-39).

test_gaps.gap: Provider-normalized SAF names are not recovered via a still-valid recorded URI. This is the same missing recorded-URI fallback already reported by reviewer-06, so it is not counted again as a new finding. docs/PUBLICATION_RECOVERY.md:16 also lists silent normalization as an explicit existing limitation.
test_gaps.reproduction_condition: Using the existing SAF fixture: set rejectRename=true; call OutputStore.save so a verified receipt and one document remain; keep the map key/documentId and bytes unchanged but replace entries[id] with entries[id].copy(name="provider-normalized.bin"); set rejectRename=false; call PublicationReceipt(context, task.id).recover(). queryChildDocuments returns the document with a different display name, line74 admits no candidate, and line82 throws PUBLICATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED on every retry even though the recorded URI remains readable and fingerprint-matching.
test_gaps.coverage_needed: A provider fault mode that normalizes create/rename display names while retaining or returning a valid URI; tests must separately cover a durable recorded URI and the pre-record creation gap.

test_gaps.gap: The fault provider cannot currently simulate a disconnected parent/root, failed child listing, or a partial/empty child listing independently of queryDocument. denyQuery only affects queryDocument; emptyQuery only affects individual document metadata. Existing storage-offline test denies reads after an exact-name candidate has already been found.
test_gaps.coverage_needed: Add controlled faults for root metadata, child-list failures and reconnect, and assert that verified documents and receipts remain intact and the original task completes after reconnect. Physical removable/cloud provider removal remains unexecuted.

test_gaps.gap: Volume-specific MediaStore absence versus primary mounted state has no test. The current tests exercise app-owned default MediaStore downloads and unknown SAF providers only. No confirmed reachable wrong-volume failure is asserted by this review.
test_gaps.coverage_needed: If secondary-volume MediaStore rows can enter the supported library, test removal/reconnection of that volume while primary remains mounted before allowing MISSING or forgetMissing.
